from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ShareCapitalRecord(BaseModel):
    """Share capital information extracted from a single document/report."""
    fiscal_year: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year of the report (e.g., '2023', '2022')")
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in the document")
    authorized_common_stock: str | None = Field(description="Authorized common stock count, exactly as written")
    outstanding_common_stock: str | None = Field(description="Outstanding common stock count, exactly as written")
    preferred_stock_details: str | None = Field(description="Details on preferred stock, e.g., shares issued or status")
    significant_changes: list[str] = Field(description="List of significant capital events described in this period")
    source_quote: str | None = Field(description="Short verbatim excerpt grounding the share capital details")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    share_capital_records: list[ShareCapitalRecord]
